# Bundled browser libraries

The MVP serves these browser libraries locally so an external script CDN is not required. License notices accompany each package.

- Leaflet 1.9.4, https://leafletjs.com/ (BSD-2-Clause)
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3, https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster (MIT)

OpenStreetMap basemap tiles remain an online service. No bulk tile prefetching is performed.
